Card Q&A.q: Does this card's [All Turns] effect activate when my opponent's Digimon activates ?

Effect: [When Digivolving] By placing 1 blue level 5 or lower Digimon card from your hand as the bottom digivolution card of this Digimon, trash the bottom 2 digivolution cards of 2 of your opponent's Digimon.
[All Turns][Once Per Turn] When a digivolution card of an opponent's Digimon is trashed, gain 1 memory.
